residualRisks: The NativeChildHandle duck-type accepts a structurally compatible handle but a malicious injected transport could spawn arbitrary commands; transport is @internal and only used by same-repo deterministic tests, so production surface is unchanged.

The injected transport validates cwd/env/stdio at the interface level only; a fake transport not exercising shell:false could drift from the real process-boundary contract, but the 27 real-child-process integration tests still guard shell:false and env propagation.

8 surviving Stryker mutants in native-plugin.ts are equivalent-to-context (waitForExit/timer cleanup and error-listener no-ops with no observable public-result side effects); uncovered 5 are defensive branches on already-settled paths.
